title: Look, Think & Answer
description: Practice answering who, what, where, when, why, and how questions using picture scenes, everyday situations, and personal responses.
learningFocus: Use picture clues and everyday knowledge to answer who, what, where, when, why, and how questions.
Give relevant answers through speaking, pointing, drawing, or writing.
adultGuidance: Read each question aloud and accept any clear answer the picture or your child's own experience supports. Speaking, pointing, drawing, and writing are all fine. Pages 1 and 2 have picture answers you can check together; pages 3 and 4 invite personal answers, like using an umbrella when it rains or asking for help when something feels unsafe.
keywords: who what where when why how questions
